articles.headline: Nasdaq rises 1.14% as chip stocks rally ahead of Fed decision
articles.summary: US stocks closed higher on Tuesday, led by gains in technology and semiconductor shares as investors assessed corporate earnings, falling oil prices, and the Federal Reserve's policy meeting. The Nasdaq Composite gained 1.14% to 26,467.06, the S&P 500 rose 0.57% to 7,720.63, and the Dow Jones Industrial Average edged up 2.44 points to 52,364.02. Broadcom climbed 4% following a $63 billion financing announcement involving banks like Bank of America, Citi, and Morgan Stanley alongside Blackstone for Anthropic's technology purchase. Micron Technology rose over 3% and Advanced Micro Devices gained 5%. West Texas Intermediate crude settled 1.70% lower at $100.03 a barrel, while Brent crude fell 1.53% to $113.99.
articles.summary_zh: 周二美国股市收高，在投资者评估企业财报、下跌的油价以及美联储政策会议之际，科技股和半导体股领涨。 纳斯达克综合指数上涨1.14%至26,467.06点，标普500指数上涨0.57%至7,720.63点，道琼斯工业平均指数微升2.44点至52,364.02点。 博通公司上涨4%，此前包括美国银行、花旗和摩根士丹利在内的多家银行与黑石集团宣布提供$63 billion的融资，用于Anthropic购买博通的技术。 美光科技上涨超过3%，超威半导体上涨5%。 西德克萨斯中质原油结算价下跌1.70%至每桶$100.03，布伦特原油下跌1.53%至$113.99。

articles.headline: AI stocks lift Wall Street closer to record
articles.summary: Influential AI stocks lifted Wall Street higher, offsetting declines across the majority of S&P 500 stocks. Broadcom climbed 4% after announcing a $US63 billion financing deal where Wall Street firms assist Anthropic in accessing Broadcom's XPU AI accelerators and networking solutions. Nvidia added 0.9%, and CoreWeave jumped 7.9%. General Motors climbed 5.5% after announcing it is moving its stock listing from the New York Stock Exchange to the Nasdaq. Treasury yields held relatively steady ahead of the Federal Reserve's interest rate decision, with the 10-year Treasury yield edging down to 4.99% from 5.00%, while Brent crude fell 1.2% to $US109.41 per barrel.
articles.summary_zh: 具影响力的AI股票推动华尔街走高，抵消了标普500指数中多数股票的跌幅。 博通公司上涨4%，此前该公司宣布了一项$US63 billion的融资交易，多家华尔街公司将协助Anthropic获得博通的XPU AI加速器和网络解决方案。 英伟达上涨0.9%，CoreWeave跃升7.9%。 通用汽车上涨5.5%，该公司宣布将其股票上市地从纽约证券交易所转移至纳斯达克。 在美联储做出利率决定前，美国国债收益率保持相对稳定，10年期国债收益率从5.00%小幅降至4.99%，同时布伦特原油价格下跌1.2%至每桶$US109.41。

articles.headline: AI Wave Drives Global Stock Market Rally Amid Policy Uncertainty
articles.summary: US stocks rallied on Tuesday, driven by AI optimism, lower oil prices, and a steady bond market as attention turned to the Federal Reserve's policy decision on Wednesday. Tech shares rose 1.5% while energy fell 2%, and the SOX chip index increased 3.6%. Three US hyperscalers are reporting third-quarter earnings this week with combined backlogs of nearly $1.7 trillion and planned spending of up to $600 billion this year. Fed interest rate futures traders placed a 90% probability on the Fed leaving rates on hold. Brazilian financial markets remained under pressure following a major stock market crash and currency drop, with the Bovespa stock index closing in the red and the real rebounding only 1%.
articles.summary_zh: 受人工智能乐观情绪、油价下跌以及债券市场稳定的推动，美国股市于周二反弹，市场焦点转向美联储周三的政策决议。 科技股上涨1.5%，能源股下跌2%，SOX芯片指数上涨3.6%。 三家美国超大规模云服务商本周将公布第三季度财报，其合并订单积压近$1.7 trillion，今年计划支出高达$600 billion。 美联储利率期货交易员预计美联储在会议结束时维持利率不变的概率为90%。 在经历重大股市崩盘和货币下跌后，巴西金融市场继续承压，伯韦斯帕指数收盘下跌，雷亚尔仅反弹1%。

articles.headline: Nasdaq rallies as AI and chip stocks outperform
articles.summary: Major US stock indices closed higher, led by outperforming AI and semiconductor shares that helped the Nasdaq Composite and Nasdaq 100 rise more than 1%. Within the Magnificent 7, Tesla led with a 4.04% advance to $407.46, followed by Amazon, which gained 1.61% to $253.10 ahead of its earnings release. Meta moved lower by 1.64% to $620.19, breaking below its 100-day and 200-day moving averages to finish near the session low. Other notable gainers included Nebius up 11.22% to $170.47, Credo Technology up 10.77% to $167.43, and Astera Labs up 10.47% to $286.69.
articles.summary_zh: 美国主要股票指数收高，在表现出色的AI和半导体股票带领下，纳斯达克综合指数和纳斯达克100指数涨幅超过1%。 在“七大科技巨头”中，特斯拉领涨4.04%至$407.46，亚马逊紧随其后，在财报发布前上涨1.61%至$253.10。 Meta下跌1.64%至$620.19，跌破100日和200日移动平均线并在接近盘中低点收盘。 其他涨幅明显的公司包括Nebius上涨11.22%至$170.47，Credo Technology上涨10.77%至$167.43，Astera Labs上涨10.47%至$286.69。

articles.headline: Broadcom and other AI stocks lift Wall Street closer to its record
articles.summary: Artificial-intelligence industry stocks led Wall Street higher on Tuesday, with the S&P 500 rising 0.7% and the Nasdaq composite gaining 1.3%. Broadcom climbed 4.1% after announcing a $63 billion financing deal involving Wall Street firms to give Anthropic access to Broadcom's XPU AI accelerators and networking solutions. General Motors rose 6.3% after announcing it is moving its stock listing from the New York Stock Exchange to the Nasdaq. JetBlue Airways gained 19.6% despite reporting a larger summer loss than analysts expected, while Royal Caribbean Group rose 8.1% after beating profit expectations and raising its full-year forecast. Boeing fell 9.2% following a larger-than-expected quarterly loss.
articles.summary_zh: 周二人工智能产业股票引领华尔街走高，标普500指数上涨0.7%，纳斯达克综合指数上涨1.3%。 博通公司上涨4.1%，此前该公司宣布了一项$63 billion的融资交易，由多家华尔街公司参与，旨在让Anthropic获得博通的XPU AI加速器和网络解决方案。 通用汽车上涨6.3%，宣布将其股票上市地从纽约证券交易所转移至纳斯达克。 捷蓝航空尽管公布的夏季亏损大于分析师预期，但仍上涨19.6%；皇家加勒比集团在利润超出预期并上调全年预测后上涨8.1%。 波音在公布大于预期的季度亏损后下跌9.2%。

articles.headline: Micron’s Long-Term Returns Crushed the S&P 500. Does the Recent Drop Matter?
articles.summary: Micron Technology experienced a recent month-long selloff, with its stock falling 15.44% from $1,082.10 on September 25 to $915.07. Despite this drop, the company's long-term returns have significantly outperformed the S&P 500, growing a $1,000 investment to $54,576.30 over a decade. The business model transformed due to high-bandwidth memory for Nvidia's AI accelerators, driving fiscal 2026 revenue up 256.3% to $133.19 billion and fiscal Q4 non-GAAP gross margin to 87.0%. Micron holds 26 strategic customer agreements running through 2030, and management reports no visibility into when supply and demand will balance. Bullish projections cite fiscal Q1 2027 revenue guidance of $61.5 billion and high shipment commitments, while bearish risks include competition for HBM4 share from Samsung and SK Hynix, capital expenditures reaching $30.7 billion in fiscal 2026, and potential Chinese memory threats.
articles.summary_zh: 美光科技经历了一个月的抛售期，股价从9月25日的$1,082.10下跌15.44%至$915.07。 尽管有所回落，其长期回报率仍远超标普500指数，在十年间将$1,000的投资增长至$54,576.30。 由于面向英伟达AI加速器的高带宽内存，公司的业务模式发生了转变，推动2026财年营收增长256.3%至$133.19 billion，第四财季非美国通用会计准则毛利率达到87.0%。 美光拥有26项持续到2030年的战略客户协议，管理层称目前尚无供需平衡的能见度。 看多预测引用了2027财年第一季度$61.5 billion的营收指引及高出货量承诺，而看空风险则包括三星和SK海力士对HBM4份额的竞争、2026财年资本支出达到$30.7 billion，以及来自中国存储芯片的潜在威胁。

articles.headline: Tesla’s Profit Fell 43% and the Stock Held Up. Here’s Why
articles.summary: Tesla reported a 42.68% drop in third-quarter net income to $787 million, while total revenue of $28.046 billion remained flat year over year and shares held up with a 0.91% decline on earnings day. The resilience stemmed from rising gross profit and a higher R&D expenditure of $2.76 billion directed toward autonomy, Optimus, and AI computing power, alongside an adjusted EPS of $0.48 that beat the $0.4511 consensus. Management cut full-year capex guidance to about $20 billion, and Elon Musk suggested a potential tie-up with SpaceX. Paid FSD subscriptions increased to 1.74 million, Austin's Cybercab fleet expanded tenfold, and energy gross margins rose to 33.1%. However, operating income dropped 55.79% and capex rose 110.5%, reducing free cash flow to $1.531 billion. Analysts maintain diverse perspectives, with a 24/7 Wall St. price target of $404.84 reflecting a hold rating.
articles.summary_zh: 特斯拉公布第三季度净利润下降42.68%至$787 million，总营收为$28.046 billion，同比持平，财报发布当日股价仅下跌0.91%。 股价坚挺源于毛利上升以及用于自动驾驶、Optimus和AI计算能力的研发支出增至$2.76 billion，同时调整后每股收益为$0.48，超出$0.4511的共识预期。 管理层将全年资本支出指引下调至约$20 billion，且埃隆·马斯克暗示可能与SpaceX进行合并。 付费FSD订阅量增至1.74 million，奥斯汀的Cybercab车队规模扩大了十倍，能源毛利率上升至33.1%。 然而，营业利润下降55.79%，资本支出增加110.5%，导致自由现金流降至$1.531 billion。 分析师持有不同观点，24/7 Wall St. 给出的目标价为$404.84，评级为持有。

articles.headline: アドバンテストの株価が続伸 米半導体指数3.6%高
articles.section: 日本株式市場 / Japan Market
articles.summary: Advantest Corporation extended its gains in the Prime market, rising 1,550 yen or 4.57% to 35,410 yen compared to the previous day. The increase followed a 3.60% rise in the Philadelphia Semiconductor Sector Index in the United States on the 27th, which comprises major semiconductor-related stocks.
articles.summary_zh: 株式会社爱德万测试在主板市场延续涨势，较前一日上涨1550日元（4.57%），报35410日元。 此前在27日，美国股市由主要半导体相关股票构成的费城半导体指数上涨了3.60%。

articles.headline: アドバンテスト、SOX3.6%高 27日は日経を600円押し上げ、きょう決算発表
articles.section: 日本株式市場 / Japan Market
articles.summary: Advantest saw continued buying following a 3.60% increase in the Philadelphia Semiconductor Sector Index, which had pushed the Nikkei up by 600 yen the previous day, ahead of its earnings announcement. Other notable morning market movements included Chugai Pharmaceutical reporting a 23% increase in net income for the January-to-September period driven by robust sales of the lymphoma treatment Lunsumio, GMO Internet Group facing ongoing cyberattacks including the public exposure of customer personal information, and Shin-Etsu Chemical recording an 11% increase in net income for the April-to-September period supported by solid demand for semiconductor materials driven by AI.
articles.summary_zh: 在费城半导体指数上涨3.60%（该指数前一日曾推动日经指数上涨600日元）之后，爱德万测试在财报发布前继续上涨。 其他早盘市场焦点包括：中外制药1至9月期纯利润增长23%，主要受淋巴瘤治疗药物“Lunsumio”销售稳健的推动；GMO互联网集团持续遭遇网络攻击，包括客户个人信息被公开；信越化学工业4至9月期纯利润增长11%，得益于AI需求带动的半导体材料表现坚挺。

articles.headline: 日経平均株価、470円61銭高で始まる - 寄り付き解説 きょうのトピック
articles.section: 日本株式市場 / Japan Market
articles.summary: The Nikkei Stock Average opened 470 yen and 61 sen higher. Market coverage highlighted Advantest following a 3.60% rise in the Philadelphia Semiconductor Sector Index and a previous session where it pushed the Nikkei up by 600 yen ahead of its earnings release. Additionally, Canon downwardly revised its net income forecast for the fiscal year ending December 2026 to a slight increase, citing production delays in medical equipment caused by component shortages.
articles.summary_zh: 日经平均指数开盘上涨470日元61仙。 市场报道重点关注了爱德万测试，该股在发布财报前因费城半导体指数上涨3.60%且前一交易日曾推高日经指数600日元而备受瞩目。 此外，佳能将截至2026年12月期的纯利润预期向下修正为微增，原因是零部件短缺导致医疗设备生产出现延迟。

articles.headline: 日経平均、日米主要企業の決算見極め（先読み株式相場）
articles.section: 日本株式市場 / Japan Market
articles.summary: 28日の東京株式市場で日経平均株価は、前日の米市場におけるAI関連銘柄の上昇を受けて買われ、6万4300円程度まで水準を切り上げると予想される。 しかし、同日に予定される米連邦公開市場委員会（FOMC）の結果公表や、日米主要企業の決算発表を見極めたいとして、上値の重い展開が見込まれている。
articles.summary_zh: 28日东京股市日经平均指数预计将因前一日美国市场人工智能相关股票的上涨而受到买盘支撑，上升至64300日元左右。 不过，由于投资者希望观望同日预定公布的美国联邦公开市场委员会（FOMC）结果以及日美主要企业的财报发布，预计该指数上方压力较大，走势沉重。

articles.headline: 【株価は最高値から10％以上も下落中で気になる「AI株」は砂上の楼閣なのか】
articles.section: 日本株式市場 / Japan Market
articles.summary: 日経平均株価は6月22日の7万2831円をピークに下降し、10月27日現在の終値で6万3268円と最高値から約13％下落している。 元日本証券新聞社社長の天野秀夫氏によると、構成銘柄の約4割を占めるAI・半導体関連株が日経平均を支えてきたが、ソフトバンクグループやキオクシアホールディングスなどの主要銘柄が直近で株価を5割以上落としていることが下振れの要因となっている。
articles.summary_zh: 日经平均指数自6月22日的72831日元高点回落，10月27日收盘价为63268日元，较最高点下跌约13%。 前日本证券新闻社社长天野秀夫表示，占成分股约四成的人工智能与半导体相关股票曾支撑日经平均指数，但软银集团和铠侠控股等主要股票近期的股价跌幅超过五成，成为导致指数下行的原因。

articles.headline: 視る日経！ニュースNEXT【ニデック永守氏ら提訴！運命の期限！上場廃止回避なるか？】
articles.section: 日本株式市場 / Japan Market
articles.summary: 不正会計問題を巡り東京証券取引所から「特別注意銘柄」に指定されているニデックは、内部管理体制確認書の提出期限を迎える中、会社側が創業者である永守重信氏ら旧役員9名に対し計276億円規模の損害賠償を求めて提訴すると発表した。 監査法人の意見不表明が残るなど改善への不透明感が漂う中、未提出や改善不十分による上場廃止が懸念されている。
articles.summary_zh: 因涉嫌财务违规被东京证券交易所指定为“特别注意铭柄”的尼得科在迎来内部管理体制确认书提交期限之际，宣布将向创始人永守重信等9名原高管提起诉讼，要求赔偿总计276亿日元的损失。 在审计机构仍存在意见不发表等改善不确定因素的情况下，外界担忧若未能提交或改善不充分，该企业将面临退市风险。

articles.headline: 日本株ADR27日、高安まちまち みずほFG上昇、ソニーGは下落
articles.section: 日本株式市場 / Japan Market
articles.summary: 27日の米株式市場における日本株の米預託証券（ADR）は高安まちまちとなった。 同日は人工知能（AI）・半導体銘柄が買われて日米の株式相場が上昇したものの、日本株ADRには売り買いが交錯した。 個別ではみずほFG、三井住友FG、三菱UFJが上昇した一方、ソニーGやホンダは下落した。
articles.summary_zh: 27日美国股市的日本股票美国存托凭证（ADR）涨跌互现。 当天人工智能与半导体股票受到追捧，带动日美股市上涨，但日本股票ADR则多空交织。 具体个股中，瑞穗金融集团、三井住友金融集团和三菱日联上涨，而索尼集团和本田则下跌。

articles.headline: GLOBAL MARKETS-Stocks Rise Ahead of Tech Earnings, Fed Decision
articles.section: 宏观经济与投资 / Macro & Investment
articles.summary: MSCI's global equities gauge rose 6.58 points, or 0.59%, to 1,129.74 on Tuesday as investors awaited tech earnings and the Federal Reserve's policy decision. Oil futures settled down nearly $2 amid prospects of Middle East peace talks, though prices remained near multimonth highs. Meta, SpaceX, Broadcom, and Anthropic's IPO filing encouraged investors with AI news. Wedbush Securities managing director Sahak Manuelian noted the AI news helped the bond market and small caps. Dow Jones rose 15.99 points to 52,377.57, S&P 500 gained 45.83 points to 7,722.60, Nasdaq rose 308.43 points to 26,477.81, and Russell 2000 rose 1.2%. Central banks including the Fed, ECB, and Bank of Japan are expected to keep interest rates on hold.
articles.summary_zh: 由于投资者等待科技企业财报以及美联储的政策决定，MSCI全球股票指标在周二上涨了6.58点，或0.59%，报1,129.74点。 受中东和平谈判前景影响，原油期货结算价下跌近$2，但价格仍接近数月高点。 Meta、SpaceX、Broadcom的人工智能相关融资消息以及Anthropic的首次公开募股申请提振了投资者信心。 Wedbush Securities全球股票销售与交易董事总经理萨哈克·马努埃利安表示，人工智能相关消息帮助债券市场企稳并推动小型股表现更好。 道琼斯工业平均指数上涨15.99点，报52,377.57点；标普500指数上涨45.83点，报7,722.60点；纳斯达克综合指数上涨308.43点，报26,477.81点；罗素2000小型股指数上涨1.2%。 包括美联储、欧洲央行和日本央行在内的各大央行预计将维持利率不变。

articles.headline: Dollar Index Climbs Back to 102 Ahead of Fed, BoJ and ECB Decision Week as Markets Position Early
articles.section: 宏观经济与投资 / Macro & Investment
articles.summary: The US Dollar Index climbed about 0.3% to reclaims the 102 level, trading near 102.29 ahead of a series of central bank decisions by the Federal Reserve, European Central Bank, and Bank of Japan, which are widely expected to keep rates unchanged. Kevin Ford, FX and macro strategist at Convera, noted that the dollar rebounded and market sentiment on AI steadied after recent stock market turbulence. Meanwhile, Bank of America analysts led by Mark Cabana warned that a dovish hold by the Fed could expose the dollar to a larger decline. The euro fell about 0.3% to around $1.1136, pressured by high energy costs, French fiscal concerns, and a widening debt risk premium, while the dollar rose about 0.24% against the yen to approximately ¥157.9 amid signals of potential foreign exchange intervention by Japanese Finance Minister Satsuki Katayama.
articles.summary_zh: 随着美联储、欧洲央行和日本央行即将公布利率决议且市场普遍预计按兵不动，美国美元指数在周二纽约尾盘上涨约0.3%并重回102关口，交投于102.29附近。 Convera外汇与宏观策略师Kevin Ford表示，在经历股市动荡后，美元已反弹且人工智能市场情绪有所趋稳。 同时美国银行以Mark Cabana为首的分析师团队指出，若美联储维持利率不变并释放鸽派基调，美元可能面临较大跌幅。 受高昂能源成本、法国财政担忧以及债务风险溢价扩大的影响，欧元兑美元下跌约0.3%至1.1136附近；而在日本财务大臣片山皋月重申准备采取果断干预措施后，美元兑日元上涨约0.24%至157.9左右。

articles.headline: Gold Below $4,000, Bitcoin Below $80,000: Why Safe Havens Failed in the AI-Stock Selloff
articles.section: 宏观经济与投资 / Macro & Investment
articles.summary: Spot gold traded at $3,995.84, down 0.52%, and bitcoin closed at $79,722 following a sharp AI-stock selloff on 22 October 2026 that triggered margin calls and forced liquidations. Justin Lin of Global X described it as a liquidity-driven selloff as investors raised cash. Additional pressure came from Brent crude settling at $116.72 after Houthi attacks on Saudi energy sites, US September CPI rising 3.7% year-on-year, and a hawkish Federal Reserve that raised its target range to 3.75% to 4.00% on 16 September. US 10-year real yields stood at 2.66% on 26 October, increasing the opportunity cost of holding non-yielding gold.
articles.summary_zh: 现货黄金交投于3995.84美元，跌幅0.52%，比特币收盘报79722美元。 此前在2026年10月22日发生的人工智能股票遭抛售引发了追加保证金通知和被迫平仓。 Global X的林Justin将其称为由流动性驱动的抛售，投资者借此筹集现金。 其他压力还包括：在胡塞武装袭击沙特能源设施后布伦特原油结算价达到116.72美元；美国9月CPI同比上涨3.7%；美联储于9月16日将目标区间上调至3.75%至4.00%。 10月26日美国10年期实际收益率为2.66%，这增加了持有无息黄金的机会成本。

articles.headline: Yen eases on risk-on mood ahead of central bank bonanza
articles.section: 宏观经济与投资 / Macro & Investment
articles.summary: The Japanese yen eased 0.1% against the US dollar to 157.66 on Tuesday, moving away from a one-month high amid a risk-on mood supported by a tech-led Wall Street rebound following Anthropic's IPO filing and Meta's $95 billion equity plan. The Bank of Japan is widely expected to keep interest rates steady at 1.25% in its upcoming meeting, though a key gauge of service-sector inflation rose 3.7% in September. OCBC currency strategist Moh Siong Sim noted the yen's potential as a safe-haven hedge could rise next year. Meanwhile, the dollar index held near 102.11, the euro fell to a near two-week low of $1.1171 due to French fiscal worries, and the New Zealand dollar rose 0.4% to 0.5702 ahead of an expected quarter-point rate hike.
articles.summary_zh: 受Anthropic提交IPO申请以及Meta推出950亿美元股权计划带动的华尔街科技股反弹所引发的风险偏好情绪影响，周二日元兑美元汇率下跌0.1%至157.66，进一步远离上周创下的一个月高点。 市场普遍预计日本央行将在即将召开的会议上维持1.25%的利率不变，尽管9月服务业通胀关键指标同比上升了3.7%。 华侨银行外汇策略师沈茂雄指出，日元作为避险对冲工具的价值明年可能会上升。 与此同时，美元指数维持在102.11附近，受法国财政担忧影响欧元跌至近两周新低的1.1171美元，而纽元则在预期加息25个基点的背景下上涨0.4%至0.5702。

articles.headline: 【US Pre-Market】US Stock Futures Rise Across the Board, Celestica Surges Over 15%, Gold Fluctuates Around $4,000, Bitcoin Drops Below $80,000 Level
articles.section: 宏观经济与投资 / Macro & Investment
articles.summary: US stock index futures rose premarket on October 27, with Dow futures up 0.21%, S&P 500 futures gaining 0.23%, and Nasdaq 100 futures rising 0.34%. Celestica surged over 15% after reporting third-quarter revenue of $5.83 billion, up 83% year-over-year, and non-GAAP adjusted EPS of $3.30, while raising its full-year 2026 revenue guidance to $21 billion and issuing a 2027 revenue target of $40 billion. HSBC fell over 6% after reporting third-quarter revenue of $18.62 billion and EPS of $0.42, both missing market expectations despite a 32% rise in pre-tax profit to $9.6 billion. In commodities, Brent crude stood at $109.96 and WTI crude at $100.71, while gold traded at $4,009 and Bitcoin dropped below $80,000 to $79,854.7 ahead of the Federal Reserve's rate decision.
articles.summary_zh: 10月27日盘前，美股三大股指期货全线上涨，道指期货涨0.21%，标普500期货涨0.23%，纳斯达克100期货涨约0.34%。 天弘科技股价飙升超过15%，该公司公布第三季度营收达$5.83 billion，同比增长83%，非美国通用会计准则调整后每股收益为3.30美元，同时将2026全年营收指引上调至210亿美元并首次给出400亿美元的2027年营收目标。 汇丰控股股价下跌超过6%，其第三季度营收为186.2亿美元，每股收益为0.42美元，尽管税前利润同比增长32%至96亿美元，但两项指标均逊于市场预期。 在大宗商品方面，布伦特原油报109.96美元，WTI原油报100.71美元，黄金交投于4009美元，在美联储公布利率决议前比特币跌破80000美元至79854.7美元。
